scope: Local offline resource ownership and truthful transport receipts. No provider, handset, production, database or deployment operations.

findings_and_repairs.root_cause: Nested STT forwarding generators did not explicitly close the child when the consumer stopped at a yielded transcript.
findings_and_repairs.before: Primary and fallback provider still open immediately after wrapper aclose returned; retained generator prevents GC from hiding the ownership gap.
findings_and_repairs.after: Each forwarding layer closes its child. Provider closes before tee/replay iterator, then outer call-owned input. Cancellation does not promote a fallback.

findings_and_repairs.root_cause: Browser completion waits and cleanup referenced one mutable session event; old fade/send/flush work mutated the current generation after awaiting.
findings_and_repairs.before: B completion certified waiting A; old wait cleanup/fade cleared B tracking; old send/flush consumed B buffer/accounting. Twilio clear did not wake its waiter.
findings_and_repairs.after: Each begin owns a new event; clear/end wake without played proof. Receipt and cleanup recheck generation. Old transport work cannot consume or account against B. Twilio retains its existing clear protocol.

findings_and_repairs.root_cause: Transport timeout dropped audio but a later correlated queue completion could still certify the full utterance.
findings_and_repairs.before: Browser and Twilio zero/partial successful sends followed by matching ack returned completed/transport_played.
findings_and_repairs.after: Per-generation failed submission is monotonic until new begin. Matching ack cannot promote it; receipt remains failed/unknown with played_ms zero. Physical submission counters remain separate.

findings_and_repairs.root_cause: Existing environment-policy test reloaded resilient_stt in the shared pytest process, replacing class identities used by later collected orchestrator tests.
findings_and_repairs.before: 253 passed / one isinstance failure despite returned object being the new instance of the same reloaded class.
findings_and_repairs.after: Existing configuration contract is checked in an isolated Python startup with synthetic environment overrides, preserving module identity in the parent test process.
